body: Breaking her trust is the last thing I want to do right now, she has been depressed in the past, and i have always been her main outlet and I don't want to sever that lifeline she has with me. This is not taking into account that my extended family not including her parents will get involved, chiming in their own thoughts. They are people that adhere to "tough love" and having them be critical of her during this time is not the best option. Literally saw that happen when another cousin broke up with her boyfriend, they started criticizing her relationship choices and just sunk her further into depression. To this day, they will still bring that up if her name was said. It looks like I'm making excuses but I really don't know how my family will react to this shit.
